entities.name: Daghatar the Adamant
entities.description: A speaker who likens the family to a tree whose every branch can be a weapon.

entities.name: Alesha, Who Smiles at Death
entities.description: A warrior associated with the creed of greeting death with sword in hand.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A deity whose blessing is sometimes a boon, sometimes a bane, and always ablaze.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A speaker who says her kin find the places where life grows strongest.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A faction whose war beasts send enemies fleeing in panic.

entities.name: Darksteel
entities.description: A material from which structures are built that yield to neither assault nor age.
